title: Tree of Sophia act record
description: One immutable act of a person or an agent in their own research: a ticket, a proposal, a reply, a review decision, a lease, a declared kind. It is local personal work. It never writes ToS source, review, rights or canon, and its review decisions are the person's own, not the Tree's. State such as a ticket's status or a place's occupancy is computed by folding the journal, never stored in a record.

kind.description: A base kind from act-kinds.v1.json, or a declared kind named x.<namespace>.<name>. An unknown kind is kept and shown generically.

targets.description: Addresses the act is about. Every act has at least one.

grounds.description: Exact source places and subject addresses the act rests on. Empty only where its kind declares grounds optional.

body.description: The kind's fields. Unknown fields are kept and shown generically.

parents.description: Acts this one grew from. Each must already be in the journal.

replaces.description: An earlier act this one corrects. The earlier act stays readable.

at.description: Creation time, canonical UTC with milliseconds.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical bytes of the record without this field. A trace marker, never a signature.

address.description: A research index ID, an exact corpus reference key, act:<id> for another act, group:<key> for a review group, kind:<name> for a kind, or another stable address. No control characters.

model.description: Required for an agent: independence is counted by model.
